en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a general view of a coastal town built amphitheatrically on a hillside beside the sea. Dense low houses line the waterfront with more buildings climbing up the hill. There is Greek postage in the upper‑right corner and several postal cancellation marks and handwritten notes across the bottom. The printed caption at the bottom center reads "Syra. – Vue Générale."
